findings.body: This branch adds the blocked API preview status but no web changes or browser tests. T4B still needs to verify removal confirmation and cancellation, the absence of a Remove control on the admin's own row, the blocked message before and at Join, clearing removals, and rejoining only after an explicit Join tap. These checks are assigned to T4B.
